description: This file defines the ExternalOAuthProviderController class for handling OAuth provider configurations within the SuiteCRM application. It extends the SugarController class and manages the 'edit' view logic, including access control based on request parameters and bean properties.

classes.name: ExternalOAuthProviderController
classes.description: Controller class for managing external OAuth provider configurations and views within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: action_EditView
methods.description: Sets the view to 'edit' for the OAuth provider configuration, manages request parameters, and determines access rights based on bean properties and request data.
